items.desc_zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统再次征收一系列关税，包括对巴西进口商品征收 25% 的关税，并承诺对加拿大商品征收 50% 的关税。

items.title_en: Warning shot or publicity stunt - how worried should we be about the OpenAI hack?
items.title_zh: 警告镜头或宣传噱头——我们应该对 OpenAI 黑客攻击有多担心？
items.desc_en: Hugging Face said the hack was done at superhuman speed by an AI with little or no human guidance.
items.desc_zh: Hugging Face 表示，这次黑客攻击是由人工智能以超人的速度完成的，几乎没有或根本没有人类指导。

items.title_en: Zelensky tries to fix crisis over removal of defence minister and counts the cost
items.title_zh: 泽伦斯基试图解决因国防部长免职而引发的危机并计算成本
items.desc_en: Protests have continued over Zelensky's decision to dismiss Mykhailo Fedorov, and some commentators believe he has been damaged politically.
items.desc_zh: 对泽伦斯基解雇米哈伊洛·费多罗夫的决定的抗议仍在继续，一些评论员认为他在政治上受到了损害。

items.title_en: ICC top prosecutor removed over sexual misconduct allegations
items.title_zh: 国际刑事法院首席检察官因不当性行为指控被免职
items.desc_en: Karim Khan denies allegations of engaging in an improper sexual relationship with a junior ICC staff member and seeking to stop her pursuing her complaint.
items.desc_zh: 卡里姆·汗否认与国际刑事法院一名初级工作人员发生不正当性关系的指控，并试图阻止她提出申诉。

items.title_en: Trump vows to investigate EU over fining of US tech companies
items.title_zh: 特朗普发誓要调查欧盟对美国科技公司的罚款
items.desc_en: The US president says fines against Google, as well as Apple, Meta and Amazon, should be "entirely reversed."
items.desc_zh: 美国总统表示，针对谷歌、苹果、Meta 和亚马逊的罚款应该“完全撤销”。

items.title_en: Ten killed in Russian attack on drone exhibition near Kyiv
items.title_zh: 俄罗斯袭击基辅附近的无人机展览，造成十人死亡
items.desc_en: The event, attended by prominent members of the Ukrainian defence industry, was hit by ballistic missiles in the middle of the day.
items.desc_zh: 乌克兰国防工业的知名人士参加了这次活动，但在中午遭到弹道导弹袭击。

items.desc_en: Sony's status page read that it was "working to resolve the issue as soon as possible".
items.desc_zh: 索尼的状态页面显示，它正在“努力尽快解决该问题”。

items.title_en: Nigeria's president approves largest military expansion in recent times
items.title_zh: 尼日利亚总统批准近期最大规模的军事扩张
items.desc_en: The government is under intense pressure to tackle a slew of armed groups, many of whom attack civilians.
items.desc_zh: 政府面临着打击大量武装团体的巨大压力，其中许多武装团体袭击平民。

items.title_en: Four Palestinians and two Israelis killed in West Bank shooting
items.title_zh: 四名巴勒斯坦人和两名以色列人在约旦河西岸枪击事件中丧生
items.desc_en: Palestinians say villagers came under attack by settlers, while the Israeli military says a Palestinian stole a weapon and opened fire on hikers.
items.desc_zh: 巴勒斯坦人称村民遭到定居者的袭击，而以色列军方则称一名巴勒斯坦人偷了武器并向徒步旅行者开枪。

items.title_en: Why Jimothy the raccoon has become a mega meme online
items.title_zh: 为什么浣熊吉莫西已成为网上的一大迷因
items.desc_en: It all began with an innocuous video shared by Seattle resident Kiana Hall on Instagram.
items.desc_zh: 这一切都始于西雅图居民 Kiana Hall 在 Instagram 上分享的一段无伤大雅的视频。

items.title_en: US imposes tariffs on dozens of trade partners over 'forced labour' imports
items.title_zh: 美国对数十个贸易伙伴征收“强迫劳动”进口关税
items.desc_en: The tariffs target around 60 trading partners over claims they failed to properly stop forced labour.
items.desc_zh: 此次关税针对约 60 个贸易伙伴，理由是它们未能妥善制止强迫劳动。

items.title_en: Lawmakers push for AI 'kill switch' after OpenAI goes rogue
items.title_zh: OpenAI 失控后，立法者推动人工智能“终止开关”
items.desc_en: A new bill would let the US government order the shutdown AI models that pose a major public threat.
items.desc_zh: 一项新法案将允许美国政府下令关闭对公共构成重大威胁的人工智能模型。

items.title_en: Google fined €890m by EU for favouring its own apps over rivals
items.title_zh: 谷歌因偏爱自己的应用而不是竞争对手而被欧盟罚款 8.9 亿欧元
items.desc_en: It is the first major enforcement action against the tech giant under the EU's new digital rules.
items.desc_zh: 这是欧盟新数字规则下针对这家科技巨头的首次重大执法行动。

items.title_en: Amazon gaming boss predicts future where players no longer need consoles
items.title_zh: 亚马逊游戏老板预测未来玩家将不再需要游戏机
items.desc_en: Jeff Gattis said the rising cost of gaming tech is likely to mean more people will stream their games online.
items.desc_zh: 杰夫·加蒂斯表示，游戏技术成本的上升可能意味着更多的人会在线玩游戏。

items.title_en: 'Let's enjoy the ride' says Elon Musk, as AI fears mount
items.title_zh: 随着人工智能的恐惧加剧，埃隆·马斯克说：“让我们享受这段旅程吧”
items.desc_en: Talking to The Economist, Musk said he doesn't care if people hate him and said he was not a racist.
items.desc_zh: 马斯克在接受《经济学人》采访时表示，他不在乎人们是否讨厌他，并表示他不是种族主义者。

items.title_en: Google burning through cash with spiralling AI costs
items.title_zh: 谷歌因人工智能成本不断上升而烧钱
items.desc_en: The company said earlier this year it expected to spend as much as $190bn on AI investments.
items.desc_zh: 该公司今年早些时候表示，预计将在人工智能投资上花费高达 1900 亿美元。

items.title_en: Teenager drops social media addiction lawsuit against Meta
items.title_zh: 青少年放弃对 Meta 的社交媒体成瘾诉讼
items.desc_en: Claims from a 15-year-old boy were set to go to trial next week in Los Angeles, but the case has now been dropped.
items.desc_zh: 一名 15 岁男孩的索赔原定于下周在洛杉矶接受审判，但此案现已被撤销。

items.title_en: OpenAI says its AI went rogue and launched 'unprecedented' cyber-attack
items.title_zh: OpenAI 称其人工智能失控并发起“前所未有”的网络攻击
items.desc_en: It is one of the first publicly disclosed cyber-attacks carried out by AI without direct human involvement.
items.desc_zh: 这是首次公开披露的由人工智能在没有人类直接参与的情况下实施的网络攻击之一。
